name: Plug and socket connector pair
summary: A plug/socket pair represents a detachable electrical connection with two mating sides.
description: A plug/socket pair represents a detachable electrical connection with two mating sides. Pin identity and mating references are needed to follow each circuit through the connector.
readingNotes: Check connector naming and pin numbering on both mating halves.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A connector pair is different from a permanent wire splice.
